record: The cron consolidation — currena-markets 4 triggers → 1, freeing the account quota for the WGC watch worker
why: The account's Workers Free plan allows 5 cron triggers; currena-api (1: every minute) + currena-markets (4) consumed all five, blocking currena-wgc-watch's two triggers (Cloudflare error 10072). The owner's instruction: dedicate only 1 cron job to the markets worker.

before.dispatch: the deployed handler branched on event.cron string equality (MAIN_CRON main · RETRY_CRON/ASIA_CRON retry · AU_CRON the AU job)

after.dispatch: time-based, derived from event.scheduledTime (UTC day/hour/minute), equivalent to the original string dispatch at every original fire time; the covering expression's extra wakes (01:00, 01:50, 07:30, 08:00, 08:30, 23:00, 23:50) log one line and return

equivalenceProof.method: the original four-expression string dispatch vs the patched time dispatch, evaluated at every minute of a full week (Mon 2026-11-23 → Sun 2026-11-29), plus the covering expression's own coverage
equivalenceProof.verdict: EQUIVALENT — the patched dispatch reproduces the original at every minute of the week, and every original fire is covered

upload.method: the patched index.js (only the var index_default scheduled handler region replaced; every other byte identical) PUT through the Workers script API with keep_bindings [secret_text, secret_key] — the EODHD_API_TOKEN secret preserved without its value ever being read or printed, the RATES KV binding and observability (invocation logs) re-declared from the fetched settings

rollback.artifacts: /home/z/markets-rollback-2026-11-24/ (the original deployed bundle byte-exact, the original and patched index.js, the upload metadata, the pre-change settings, the equivalence test)
rollback.procedure: PUT the original index.js with the same metadata, then PUT the four original schedules as a bare array

ownerActionNeeded: the markets worker's SOURCE (the owner's monorepo, packages/insights — not this repo) still carries the string dispatch and the four-cron wrangler config; the next deploy from that source would revert the dispatch and re-request four triggers. Port the time-based dispatch + the single covering cron into the source repo (the deployed patch is the reference), or the reverts will re-break the quota.
